name: CRR_USDVT_Adult_Indicators
title: US DVT - Adult: referral indicators
publisher: Health New Zealand | Te Whatu Ora - Community Referred Radiology Programme
description: Atomic clinical indicators for the US DVT (Adult) national referral criteria (National Community Referral Criteria for Imaging Part I, v2.0, published 09/04/2026, pp.36-37). NOT CLINICALLY SIGNED OFF (demo transcription, AD-35). The LLM extraction step, structured referral forms and the Criteria Viewer tick-list produce a QuestionnaireResponse against this Questionnaire, which the CQL library CRR_USDVT_Adult evaluates. Each answer may carry the answer-evidence extension (status documented|inferred, quote). No item carries an SDC initialExpression: there is no population library for this site. workup.dvtClinicalSuspicionHigh is in the AD-17 attestation category and is answered by the referrer, never the extraction model.
